name: Irregular
desc: Frontier AI security lab that stress-tests advanced AI models against cyberattacks and misuse before deployment.
markets: Frontier AI labs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google) and government agencies, mainly US and Israel
talks: Calcalist (CTech) reported Irregular is raising more than USD 100M at a USD 1.5B valuation, led by Thrive Capital and Greenoaks; financing not yet finalised.
raised_so_far: USD 80M in total across two 2025 rounds (Sep 2025 round led by Sequoia and Redpoint at about USD 450M valuation), per Calcalist and TechCrunch
status_detail: No announcement found; last seen reported 23 Sep 2026 (Calcalist: 'financing has not yet been finalized'). A 17 Nov 2026 search found only the 2025 USD 80M round announced.
rationale: AI-security brand selling to AI labs; cyber rivals CrowdStrike, Zscaler, Okta, Bitdefender already use F1 for B2B visibility.

name: GSR
desc: Crypto market maker and OTC trading firm providing liquidity and capital-markets services to token issuers and institutions.
markets: Institutional crypto trading and token issuers worldwide, with offices across Europe, US and Asia
talks: Bloomberg reported Standard Chartered's SC Ventures backed GSR at a valuation above USD 1B (first outside shareholder); follow-ups say GSR is raising up to USD 150M from further strategic investors, final size and valuation may change.
raised_so_far: Unclear: reports call SC Ventures the first external investor in GSR's 12-year history, while Ledger Insights cites USD 167M previously received (control holder CNC Inversiones)
status_detail: SC Ventures' stake was made public in May 2026 with the >USD 1B valuation attributed to Bloomberg; no primary announcement found of the full USD 150M round closing (only aggregator listings). Last seen reported 6 May 2026 (Catenaa, updated 2 Jun 2026).
rationale: Crypto liquidity firm in a sector where OKX, Crypto.com, Kraken and Gate.io buy F1 for institutional credibility.
